answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a falcon patrolling for Sybil nodes by mandating capital commitment. An attacker must acquire a massive stake to control consensus, effectively locking their wealth in an ivory tower of non-liquid assets. Unlike a raven picking at scraps, an adversary incurs prohibitive economic costs because each illicit identity requires proportional collateral, rendering the fabrication of multiple identities unprofitable compared to honest participation.
